Only one source loop and its explicit authority binding/provenance differ; all16 oracles and production/governing inputs remain exact. Direct dependents and neutral governance PASS. Original mode proof fails under actual ignored-report read denial; repaired mode proof recovers report data from the tracked capture and passes without an ignored-report read.

falsify.hypothesis: Success refreshes old source/oracles, loses value kinds/events/exits, confuses consumer JSON copies with actual-object detachment, or replay silently requires an ignored intermediate report.

falsify.red_control: Tracked historical original fails on both routes; successor passes all7 unchanged oracles. String count, lost event, false detachment and missing typed exit corrupt actual observation copies and reject; actual-tree alias controls reject in each producer, then healthy captures pass. Original mode producer fails on the denied intermediate-report read; repaired producer passes with zero original-report reads using only tracked report data.
